minutes.headline: Highfield Village hearing continued to April 13th after abutters raised traffic, water and school concerns
minutes.summary: The Planning Board reviewed an ANR for 205 Sunset Lane, opened the Highfield Village subdivision hearing with abutter testimony, and continued it to a set date. It then held a public discussion on the draft Village Center District bylaw and the Architectural Preservation District bylaw, with many suggested changes. It approved January minutes, heard committee reports, and one member announced he will not run again.

votes.motion: Extend and continue the Highfield Village public hearing to April 13th.

budget_items.what_was_said: The applicant's representative estimated tax revenue from the new homes would offset demands on town services.
Sewer would be extended up Maple Parkway at the developer's expense.

decisions.decision: Hearing continued to a hard date of April 13th; a six-week turnaround for the consulting engineer was accepted.
The planner will review the binder and the chiefs and DPW director on earlier objections to a Mass Avenue entrance and report back.
Planner to revise the Village Center draft with tonight's changes and post it before March 2nd.
Planner to ask the fire department about blasting permit and pre-blast survey process for next hearing.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to continue the Highfield Village subdivision public hearing to April 13th, after a six-week turnaround for the consulting engineer was accepted.
Abutters at the Highfield Village hearing raised traffic, single egress, well water, septic, taxes and school capacity.
The planner will review earlier objections to a Mass Avenue entrance with the chiefs and DPW director, and ask the fire department about blasting permits for the next hearing.
The board discussed the draft Village Center District bylaw, and the planner will revise it and post it before March 2nd.
The board also took public comment on the Architectural Preservation District bylaw, with no vote taken on it.

why_it_matters: Highfield Village is still undecided, so neighbors' concerns about traffic, wells and school crowding, and the developer's tax revenue estimate, remain open questions for the hearing record.

The Village Center and Architectural Preservation District bylaws could change what can be built or reused in village areas, including town-owned buildings, and may later go to Town Meeting for a vote.
watch_next: April 13th: continued Highfield Village public hearing.
Revised Village Center District draft, to be posted before March 2nd.
